_meta.scope: All-time (real operating years ['2025', '2026']); lines ['WeighRight', 'AMS', 'Maisa 1', 'Maisa 2+3']; FINISHED-UNIT machine-throughput. Year & month are slice dims.

metric_defs.units_per_operator_hour: sum(actual units) / sum(run-hours x operators) -- labor productivity

_meta.uom_note: MAIN sections count FINISHED UNITS (sellable boxes/bags, numeric item#s) -- UOM-pure and comparable across all four lines and Tea vs APG. Individual TB*/NTB* tea-bags (intermediate Maisa output, ~30-40x the finished rate) are NOT blended in; they live in `tea_bag_output`. 'Clean'/cleaning pseudo-rows excluded.

excluded_stages.Assembly: sampler line -- not one of the 4 throughput lines
excluded_stages.Blending: base stage, lbs UOM -- never blended into finished-unit throughput

_meta.family_rule: governed CatalogSmith cfo_class (item#==SKU) wins; else line-inferred (Maisa*->Tea, WeighRight/AMS->APG)
_meta.wage_note: Throughput is a units/time metric -- no dollars, so wage confirmation is not a caveat here.

data_quality.note: Rows missing/zero run-time or quantity are excluded from rates and counted as runs_excluded per cell.
